RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the February 24, 2009/Phalguna 5, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Culture;
Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
36
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Development of rural tourism
*101. SHRI ISHWAR SINGH:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been a perceptible
drop in the inflow of foreign tourists
visiting rural tourism sites in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government proposes to
offer some bonanza for foreign tourists who
will avail facilities in rural areas; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Social responsibilities of oil
companies
†*102. SHRI SHIVANAND
TIWARI:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that keeping in
view the corporate social responsibility,
oil companies of the country have agreed
to spend two per cent of their annually
earned profit on social reform activities;
(b) if so, whether Government has
prepared any roadmap for social reform
activities to be undertaken by public sector
oil companies;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the details of the amount spent by
these companies during the years 2005-06,
2006-07 and 2007-08 and the amount spent
in the year 2008-09 till December, in this
regard?
Tourist spots in the country
*103. SHRI SABIR ALI: Will the
Minister of TOURISM be pleased to state:
(a) the details of tourist spots in the
country;
(b) the details of income accrued from
them and expenditure incurred thereon
during the last three years;

37
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) the places which are being demanded
to be developed as tourist spots; and
(d) what are the plans in this regard?
Tourism scenario in the country
*104. MS. MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has worked
out a new action plan to declare 2009 as
the 'Visit India Year';
(b) if so, the details of such a boost;
(c) the status of foreign tourist arrivals
in India in 2008;
(d) the action plan of Government to
give a boost to medical tourism in the
country; and
(e) the status of 'Incredible India'
campaign in foreign lands and how far it
has helped to add to our foreign exchange
kitty during 2008?
PNG connection
*105. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether consequent upon
installation of Piped Natural Gas (PNG)
connection, a consumer is required to
surrender LPG connection to the former
supplier alongwith both LPG cylinders;
(b) whether there had been instances
when the PNG is not available round the
clock, with the result that one has to make
alternative arrangement for cooking;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the LPG
suppliers do not accept the surrender of
one cylinder by the consumer;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(e) what measures Government
proposes to remedy the situation?
Development of airports in Madhya
Pradesh
†*106. SHRIMATI SUSHMA
SWARAJ: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIA TION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the land required for the
airports of Bhopal, Khujaraho and Indore
in Madhya Pradesh has been acquired to
make them airports of international
standard;
(b) if so, the latest status of
development work at these airports after
acquiring the land; and
(c) whether any time limit has been fixed
to make these airports of international
standard?
Tourism development projects in
Bihar and Uttar Pradesh
*107. SHRI NAND KISHORE
Y ADAV:
SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of tourism development
projects sanctioned for Uttar Pradesh and
Bihar during the last two years, till date
and the funds sanctioned or released for
each of these projects, district-wise;
(b) the details of the funds spent,
year-wise and State-wise;
(c) whether any proposal from Uttar
Pradesh and Bihar is pending for clearance;
and

38
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor?
Development of tourism in Karnataka
*108. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the Minister of TOURISM
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of proposals submitted
by the State Government of Karnataka for
the development of tourism in that State
and pending at present for clearance by the
Centre;
(b) the details of each proposal; and
(c) the number, out of them, likely to be
cleared by the end of 2009-10 with details
of the Central assistance to be provided in
each case?

the Minister of CORPORATE AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:

computers had come to the notice of
